prado.name: Prado Museum
prado.hours: Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00 · Sun and holidays 10:00–19:00 · closed 1 Jan, 1 May, 25 Dec
prado.tip: Go in the free evening slot but arrive early; the queue is long. The Velázquez and Goya rooms are the core.
prado.best: Weekday morning, or the free evening slot

royal-palace.name: Royal Palace of Madrid
royal-palace.price_text: €14 basic ticket · reduced rates for students and seniors · check on the day
royal-palace.hours: Usually 10:00–18:00 winter, 10:00–19:00 summer · closed on some state days
royal-palace.tip: Book online to skip the ticket line. Changing of the guard is on selected mornings only, so check the day before.

plaza-mayor.name: Plaza Mayor
plaza-mayor.tip: Sit at a café for the view but eat elsewhere; terrace prices are high. Come early for photos without crowds.

retiro.name: Retiro Park
retiro.price_text: Free · rowing boats on the lake cost extra
retiro.hours: Daily, roughly 06:00–22:00 in summer, shorter in winter
retiro.tip: Rent a rowing boat on the lake and see the Crystal Palace. It is huge, so pick one corner and walk slowly.
retiro.best: Late afternoon in spring or autumn

reina-sofia.name: Reina Sofia Museum
reina-sofia.price_text: €12 general · free on some weekday evenings, check on the day
reina-sofia.hours: Closed Tuesday · otherwise roughly 10:00–21:00, shorter on Sunday
reina-sofia.tip: Go straight to Guernica on floor 2, then work backwards. Free slots are crowded.

puerta-del-sol.name: Puerta del Sol
puerta-del-sol.tip: Find the Km 0 stone slab and the bear-and-strawberry-tree statue. It is a meeting point, not a long stop.
puerta-del-sol.best: Any time; busiest in the evening

debod.name: Temple of Debod
debod.price_text: Free · interior visits limited, check on the day
debod.hours: Park always open · temple interior has short opening hours
debod.tip: Best at sunset, when the temple is lit and the park fills up. Bring a jacket in winter.

gran-via.name: Gran Vía
gran-via.tip: Walk it after dark for the neon signs and the theatres. Watch your bag in the crowds.

almudena.name: Almudena Cathedral
almudena.price_text: Free entry to the main nave · museum and dome may charge, check on the day
almudena.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–20:30, shorter on Sunday around mass
almudena.tip: Step inside for the colourful ceiling, then cross to the palace square. Dress respectfully.

uam.name: Autonomous University of Madrid (Cantoblanco)
uam.hours: Campus open on weekdays · check on the day
uam.tip: It is a working campus far north of the centre, not a tourist sight. Visit only if you have business there.

metropolitano.name: Estadio Metropolitano
metropolitano.price_text: Tour and match prices vary · check on the day
metropolitano.hours: Tours on selected days · match days vary
metropolitano.tip: Book a stadium tour or a match ticket well ahead. It is far from the centre, so allow travel time.
metropolitano.best: Match day, or a booked tour

guernica.name: Guernica (Picasso)
guernica.price_text: Included in the Reina Sofia ticket
guernica.hours: Same as Reina Sofia · closed Tuesday
guernica.tip: No photos allowed. Stand close to see the grey tones, then step back for the whole composition.

las-meninas.name: Las Meninas (Velázquez)
las-meninas.tip: Find it in room 12. Go early, as the crowd in front of it builds fast.

warner.name: Parque Warner Madrid
warner.price_text: Day tickets vary by date · check on the day
warner.hours: Seasonal · usually open daily in summer, weekends off-season
warner.tip: It is far outside the city; book a shuttle or check the train. Buy tickets online for lower prices.

atracciones.name: Parque de Atracciones de Madrid
atracciones.price_text: Day tickets vary · check on the day
atracciones.tip: In Casa de Campo, reachable by metro. Good for families with older kids.

cibeles.name: Plaza de Cibeles
cibeles.tip: See the fountain and the Cybele Palace from the traffic island crossings. Best photographed from the Paseo del Prado side.
cibeles.best: Evening, when the building is lit

alcala.name: Puerta de Alcalá
alcala.tip: Walk through it into Retiro Park. Traffic is heavy, so cross at the lights.

teatro-real.name: Royal Theatre (Teatro Real)
teatro-real.price_text: Guided tours and opera tickets vary · check on the day
teatro-real.hours: Box office and tours on selected days
teatro-real.tip: Book opera or a guided tour online. The building faces the palace across the square.

bernabeu.name: Santiago Bernabéu
bernabeu.price_text: Tour and match prices vary · check on the day
bernabeu.hours: Tours on selected days · match days vary
bernabeu.tip: Book the Bernabéu tour online. Match tickets sell out early.

teleferico.name: Teleférico de Madrid
teleferico.price_text: Return ticket roughly €6–8 · check on the day
teleferico.tip: Ride from Paseo del Pintor Rosales to Casa de Campo for city views. Check it is running before you go.

telepizza.name: Telepizza
telepizza.price_text: Pizza from roughly €10 · check on the day
telepizza.hours: Varies by branch · many open late
telepizza.tip: A Spanish pizza chain, not a sight. Fine for a quick cheap meal, but try local tapas first.

garden-earthly.name: The Garden of Earthly Delights (Bosch)
garden-earthly.tip: Find it in room 56A. Give it time; the details reward a slow look.

san-miguel.name: Mercado de San Miguel
san-miguel.price_text: Tapas and drinks roughly €3–8 each · check on the day
san-miguel.tip: Busy and pricey but fun for a first taste of tapas. Go before 13:00 to get a spot.

latina-walk.name: La Latina and Cava Baja tapas walk
latina-walk.price_text: Pay per tapa and drink · roughly €20–35 per person
latina-walk.hours: Best from evening · many bars closed on Monday
latina-walk.tip: Bar-hop along Cava Baja and Cava Alta. Eat standing at the bar like locals.

templo-viewpoint.name: Príncipe Pío riverside viewpoint
templo-viewpoint.tip: Walk the Madrid Río path and watch the sunset behind the palace. Bring water in summer.

malasana-walk.name: Malasaña neighbourhood walk
malasana-walk.price_text: Free to walk · cafés and bars extra
malasana-walk.tip: Vintage shops by day, bars by night. Wander Plaza del Dos de Mayo.

prado-tour.name: Prado guided tour
prado-tour.price_text: Roughly €30–45 per person · check on the day
prado-tour.tip: A guide helps you pick the key works in a huge museum. Book online and arrive 15 minutes early.

churros.name: Churros con chocolate at a classic café
churros.tip: A Madrid breakfast tradition. Order churros with thick hot chocolate and dip.
